verdict.rationale: Bugbot runs automatically on PR events. Users can define rules that shape what happens on each run: BUGBOT.md review guidelines, org-wide rules in Bugbot Automations, and natural-language conditions that set effort levels dynamically. However, the trigger is fixed to PR review, and there is no documented general-purpose engine for arbitrary event-to-action rules. Missing for 10: user-definable event triggers beyond PR updates, configurable actions other than reviews, detailed docs on what Bugbot Automations can trigger, independent corroboration of rule-driven automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Runs automatic reviews on every PR update
When enabled, Bugbot automatically runs AI code review in the background on new PRs.
Team admins can also create organization-wide rules in [Bugbot Automations](https://cursor.com/automations/from-cursor/bugbot).
Describe in natural language when Bugbot should use low, default, or high effort. Cursor will dynamically set effort levels based on your instructions.
Create `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` files in your repository to give Bugbot project-specific review guidelines.
